geometry: Taper side banks cut shorter along original paths with rounded closures; upper height and six rear banks preserved. New Crop uses a closed crown-to-front sculpt with shallow irregular clumps, slight diagonal drift and no hard part. Curly crown retained.
directional_fade: Actual214 rounded curved fine-direction mesh reused and reseated on the current head; original vertex opacity retained. Smooth258 base field retained without the ripple/white-glint artifact.
rendering: Main hair cores remain OPAQUE. Fade, direction marks and narrow terminal boundaries use BLEND vertex opacity; no transmission/refraction. Preserve COLOR_0 alpha and material separation. A nearest-opaque baker alone cannot reproduce these edges.
colors: Palettes unchanged, including neutral Black#303030. Material shade control retains hairShade258 as a compatibility key. Ombré buffers preserve geometry/UV/indices/normals/transforms and opacity. Taper/Crop Ombré now follows authored root-to-tip flow after the glTF UV flip; roots stay darker and grown ends lighten.
coordinates: Shared coordinates and independently selectable/recolorable components preserved. No recentering or per-component resizing.
exports: 72 ordinary GLBs:24 hair,24 Ombré,24 seated sprouts. Three packed final-GLB assemblies and30 matched120/512 color/Z pairs.
references: Color and32-bit Z share final geometry/camera/version, alpha threshold0.5. These assembled references are not a complete component/alpha occlusion bake. Regenerate both together when geometry or camera changes.
lighting: Fixed studio/camera/exposure/color management recorded in assemblies259.json. Blender shader/tonemapping effects do not transfer identically through GLB.
controls: Compare258 shows the previous Taper, Side part and Curly side detail.214 directional reference is a matched board; original raised B comparison remains available for bare Taper.
qualification: Artwork/browser export checks only. Native alpha rendering and phone performance qualification remain separate.
profile_contract: No wire/profile-byte assignment, mobile renderer or product-repository changes.
